description: Matrix4: add, sub, scale, mul, mul_vec, tr_mul, transpose, trace, determinant, try_inverse (regular, singular, near-singular), outer

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: matrix4_scale
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix4_mul
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix4_mul_vec
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix4_tr_mul
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix4_outer
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: matrix4_try_inverse
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_try_inverse_singular
ops.doc: a.try_inverse().is_some() on exactly singular integer-valued matrices

ops.name: matrix4_try_inverse_near_singular
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: matrix4_determinant
ops.tolerance: ceil(24 * amax^2 + 24 * amax + 8 + 24 * amax^4 * 2^-20), amax = max |a_ij|: one-ulp errors on the 2x2 minors multiplied by the complementary minors, plus the f64 oracle's own error
